player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Cuir a-mach gnìomh bràisteachd aonar, m.e. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', no '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Cannot [check] - you are facing a bet.
invalid_move.amount_min: Feumaidh an t-suim geall / àrdachadh a bhith ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Chan eil dad ri ghairm; faodaidh tu [check] an àite sin.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Cleachd [bet X] gus fosgladh; chan eil geall ri àrdachadh.
invalid_move.insufficient: Chan eil criomagan gu leòr airson an gnìomh sin.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: an dà chuid {card}. Pot roinnte  gach fear a 'faighinn {split} .

outcome.draw: Chip co-ionann às deidh gach cuairt.
